items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And then there was Louis, let me see, I tried to remember the names of them.

ctx.x: I talked to one of them.

Yeah, I just happened to catch them last night. Eureka band, about four or five of them were playing, playing when the Saints were marching in. And then there was Louis, let me see, I tried to remember the names of them.
